verdict.rationale: Drata documents a hosted trust center: SafeBase Trust Center branding and custom URL setup, a Trust Center Analytics Dashboard, and API-based trust center management with questionnaire automation aimed at speeding up security reviews. The pack's evidence consists only of article titles and taglines, so none of the story's specific trust-center contents are shown. Missing for 10: evidence of live control status display, certification and report hosting, click-through NDA gating for document access, and independent or hands-on corroboration that it shortens security reviews.
